data.description: Primary Chinese wordmark for 声间 (Shengjian): the two characters in ultra-heavy geometric CJK display lettering with structurally correct strokes, caption "SHENGJIAN" in letter-spaced monospace, acid chartreuse on pure black. Chosen by the user as the overall brand logo; characters kept free of any merged decoration after the first CJK attempt broke the stroke structure of 间.
data.variant_note: Third round of logo exploration: c2 (waveform underline) rejected for edge artifacts, c3 (pure type) adopted. Earlier candidates and rejection reasons recorded in docs/ui/ui-direction.md session notes.

reuse: Derived from untracked working file output/imagegen/logo-c3-cjk-pure-type.png: black margins trimmed to content plus 6% padding (1087x598); interior speckle blobs filled programmatically; the "SHENGJIAN" caption was re-typeset programmatically in Consolas Bold at the original size, letter-spacing and muted-gray color (source caption was grainy). Saved as lossless WebP. Intended display size up to ~500px wide; the character forms carry generation grain at large zoom. Used as the README.zh-CN.md header logo.
